title: Client Bookkeeper
description:
Client Bookkeeper - Helston - £27,000 - £35,000

If you're an experienced bookkeeper looking for a role where you'll work with a varied client portfolio, become part of a supportive team and continue developing your skills, this could be an excellent opportunity to consider.

A highly respected accountancy practice in Helston is looking to recruit an experienced Client Bookkeeper to join its team. This is a varied role offering regular client exposure, a broad range of bookkeeping responsibilities and plenty of opportunity for personal and professional development.

As Client Bookkeeper, your responsibilities will include:
- Completing day-to-day bookkeeping for a varied portfolio of clients
- Supporting the maintenance of accounts payable and accounts receivable records
- Completing regular bank reconciliations and ensuring financial records remain accurate and up to date
- Preparing VAT reports and supporting clients with their ongoing VAT requirements
- Assisting with wider accounting duties and ad-hoc tasks as required
- Working closely with clients and colleagues to ensure information is accurate and deadlines are met

The successful Client Bookkeeper will:

Have previous bookkeeping experience gained within an accountancy practice environment and be confident managing a varied workload across multiple clients.

You may be part or fully AAT qualified, or alternatively be qualified by experience. Strong communication skills will be essential, alongside the ability to build positive and professional relationships with both clients and colleagues.

You'll be organised, accurate and comfortable taking ownership of your work, whilst also enjoying being part of a successful and supportive team.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced bookkeeper to join a successful accountancy practice where your contribution will be valued, your skills can continue to develop and you'll become an important part of the wider team.

Please apply to this Client Bookkeeper position or contact Jay Vilarrubi-Smith, quoting reference JVS11287, for a confidential conversation.

Trial Balance is a market leading supplier of recruitment services to accountancy practices across the South-West and works on vacancies at all levels in a practice environment. For a confidential discussion about your career options please contact Jay Vilarrubi-Smith, our dedicated practice specialist.

title: Part Time Bookkeeper
description:
Part-Time Bookkeeper - Redruth (outskirts) - Salary negotiable depending on experience

Trial Balance Consulting are delighted to have been exclusively engaged by a long-established and highly regarded Cornish business, who seek to recruit a part-time Bookkeeper to join their team on a permanent basis.

The role will see you work 2 days per week (16hrs), with one of those days required to be a Monday (the client is flexible around the second working day). There may be scope for the hours to vary in the future for the right candidate, and whilst the role will initially be site based, there is potential for some working from home to develop.

Working with an experienced Finance Manager the successful candidate will take responsibility for a varied range of transactional finance, bookkeeping and payroll administration duties.

Using Sage Line 50, the role will involve the following key responsibilities:
- Manage day-to-day bookkeeping and transactional finance duties
- Process purchase and sales ledger transactions
- Maintain accurate financial records and undertake regular bank reconciliations
- Assist with payroll administration
- Support with month-end procedures and reporting
- Liaise with suppliers and other contacts as required
- Provide general support to the wider finance function

For this role we seek an experienced Bookkeeper or Accounts Assistant with a good understanding of day-to-day transactional finance procedures. Previous experience using Sage Line 50 will be essential and some knowledge of payroll administration would be advantageous.

We're looking for someone organised, reliable and comfortable working independently, whilst also being a good team player with strong communication skills.

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Temporary Payroll Assistant - £14.00 - £15.00 per hour - Full or Part Time - Initial 3 Month Contract with Potential for Extension

An established business is seeking a Payroll Assistant to join its payroll team on a temporary basis. This role has been created to provide additional support during a particularly busy period and will focus on payroll administration, data entry, reconciliations, and supporting the accurate processing of monthly payrolls.

Working as part of an experienced payroll team, you will play a key role in ensuring payroll information is processed accurately and on time across multiple payrolls, while assisting with HMRC reporting and payroll administration duties.

Key Responsibilities

Processing and maintaining payroll records

Accurate input and validation of payroll data

Supporting the monthly processing of two payrolls covering approximately 700 employees across multiple entities

Processing new starters and leavers

Assisting with payroll reconciliations and balancing activities

Supporting HMRC submissions, RTI reporting and general payroll compliance

Assisting with statutory payments including SSP and other payroll-related calculations

Supporting pension administration and submissions

Working with time and attendance data to ensure payroll accuracy

Investigating and resolving payroll discrepancies

Responding to payroll-related queries from employees and managers

Providing general administrative support to the wider payroll function

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in a Payroll Assistant, Payroll Administrator, or similar payroll support role, together with a good understanding of payroll processes and administration. You will have excellent attention to detail, strong data entry skills, and be comfortable working with large volumes of information while maintaining a high degree of accuracy.

You should be organised, dependable, and capable of managing priorities within a deadline-driven environment. Knowledge of UK payroll legislation and HMRC requirements would be advantageous, as would experience using payroll software such as MorePay or time and attendance systems such as Kronos, although neither is essential.

Please apply ASAP to Elle Benjamin quoting reference EB11279.
